notes.title: Release Notes for 2/18/2021
notes.content:
[h3]Constructor[/h3]
Added the ability to create and edit custom switch collections.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39097388/e3c48e99daf7006b405194b80dcc5946328ce117.gif[/img]

[h3]Privacy[/h3]
Added privacy settings for Microsoft Edge (Chromium)

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
Fix maximized state bug (thx JunglePredator)
Various UI and under-the-hood improvements.

[h3]Note:[/h3]
We will provide a full translation and add new languages closer to the release when all the stated features are implemented. Up to this point, you may notice some untranslated words and sentences. You can also participate in the translation yourself [url=https://translation.dashboardx.app]here[/url].

notes.title: Release Notes for 12/29/2020
notes.content:
[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
New tab for all non-privacy settings. It's pretty empty right now, but we'll try to fix it in the future updates (send us your suggestions!). Also, with the upcoming release of the [b]Constructor[/b], you will be able to add switches to this section yourself.

[h3]Collections 2.0[/h3]
For more convenience and understanding, we have redesigned the switch collections. Now each collection can have different types of switches. The switch type is now marked with the corresponding icon.

[h3]Context menu and ability to hide built-in switches[/h3]
For the built-in settings, we have added the ability to hide those that you don't use. To do this, just right-click on the switch and select [b]Hide this switch[/b]. The switch will be moved to a separate Hidden collection.

[h3]Constructor[/h3]
Added ability to edit custom switch.

[h3]Weight loss[/h3]
Removed Redistributables folder (dotNet 4.8), Steam will take care of installing it if needed.

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
Various UI and under-the-hood improvements.
